note: Adapted from the account of Hill (1922) in English; for perniger the original gives only comparisons and a discussion with D. rubriceps and D. daliensis (including the key characters of Mjöberg) and no separate full description; the measurements are taken from the perniger column of the side-by-side soldier measurement table in that paper.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Typically of the dark-headed form; mandibles very long, the teeth on the mandibles broad and prominent. It differs from D. rubriceps (per Mjöberg's key) in the very long mandibles with broad, prominent teeth, whereas rubriceps has shorter mandibles with triangular teeth. Mjöberg notes that specimens from different localities vary considerably in head colour, size and head shape, but found no stable character on which to base a species; Hill, on the other hand, considered that soldiers with different head-colour intensities belong to alates that differ clearly at species level and cannot be merged. Measurements (listed together with D. daliensis): head with mandibles 3.196 mm; mandible length 1.598 mm; head depth 1.034 mm; head width 1.598 mm; antenna length 3.666 mm; pronotum length 0.564 mm, width 1.081 mm; length of the fore, mid and hind tibiae 1.457, 1.363, 2.303 mm.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier with very long mandibles and broad, prominent teeth; the head shallower (depth 1.034 mm, about two thirds that of D. daliensis); the pronotum narrower (width 1.081 mm).
